source_text: Laeti sumus si Scriptura moneat ut recedamus a vitiis, magis si ordinis nostri aliquos Dei sermo perstringat volentes sanari. Gloria Deo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: We are glad if Scripture warns that we withdraw from vices, more if the word of God touches some of our order who wish to be healed. Glory to God. Amen.
pass_b_english: Rejoice when Scripture warns us off vices — still more when God’s word strikes our own rank so we turn and are healed. Glory to God. Amen.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel.
anf_compare: no ANF for Jerome Ezekiel homilies; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel
